candidates.title: Kino der Toten (For realsies)
candidates.known_notes: Release explicitly says sources are included. Later update reports most spawns/waypoints fixed plus lighting/detail work and source files published.

candidates.title: Facility V2
candidates.known_notes: Abandoned research facility. .map included; waypoint, clipping, interact trigger and zone-file fixes documented.

candidates.title: Simulacra
candidates.known_notes: Simulated American town in a German viral testing facility; project files public; clipping/geometry/zombie stuck spots cleaned in updates.

candidates.title: Perish
candidates.known_notes: J.A.C.K project files published; WADs embedded into BSP in update. Strong candidate for complete Enhanced reskin because base map intentionally uses dev textures.

candidates.title: Isolation
candidates.known_notes: Original community map with teleporter, zapper trap, PaP, easter eggs and corrected special waypoints; tiny ground bumps were removed to avoid zombie stuck spots.

candidates.title: Yukon Yard
candidates.known_notes: Original lumber-yard survival map with perks, PaP, bunker/buyable ending and Ray Gun Mark II availability.

candidates.title: Shipment Survival
candidates.known_notes: Small/tight NZ:P recreation, mystery box + four classic perks. v1.1 fixed glitch spots and added Ray Gun Mark II to box list.

candidates.title: BO2 Town
candidates.known_notes: PaP, 13 wall buys, dogs, custom skybox, perks and traps. Later download fixed a zombie stuck spot near Quick Revive.

candidates.title: Bus Depot
candidates.known_notes: Stable NZ:P Bus Depot recreation with box locations, perks/power and buyable ending; later update fixed pathfinding and geometry.

candidates.title: Der Riese Updated
candidates.known_notes: Original discussion points users to a newer updated release. Must audit latest package before Android integration.

candidates.title: Das Alte Haus
candidates.known_notes: Remake of a WaW custom-zombies map; includes Kino-style PaP, core perks, dog rounds, ambience and spawn zones.

candidates.title: No Man's Land
candidates.known_notes: Based on Moon spawn; staged zombie spawns, teleporter/shop, teddies and buyable ending.

candidates.title: Nuketown Zombies [Mod-Friendly] (BO3)
candidates.known_notes: Public script repository for a modern BO3 Nuketown Zombies map. Geometry/Workshop files are not included.

candidates.title: Nuketown Light Edition (Source/TTT)
candidates.known_notes: Author publicly posted a VMF mapfile. Brush geometry is technically more convertible than a mesh/BSP, but rights/texture provenance and permission must be audited before bundling.

candidates.title: Nuketown for GMod/nZombies
candidates.known_notes: Community Nuketown map/config with navmesh/nZombies ecosystem support. Uses ported COD props, so do not import those assets into Enhanced.
